column3: 3.  The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column2: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column3: to provide medical aid and food to the poor and the
destitute and constucting houses and shelters;
to conduct special services for needy school children
and to offer assistance by way of scholarships, library
facilities and other necessary support for students;
to conduct classes for the students sitting for   year
five  scholarship,  GCE    (O/L)  and  GCE  (A/L)
examinations  by  experts  in  the  particular  field  of
education;
to  establish  and  maintain  pre-schools  for  early
childhood development of the needy  children;
to give aid by way of scholarships to any officer or
servants engaged in the furtherance of the objects of
the  Corporation;
to  promote  understanding,  co-operation  and
friendship  with  similar  institutions  within  and
outside Sri Lanka;
to  organize  employees  of  small  and  medium  scale
industries and enterprises and working towards their
future  advancement;
to  design  and  implement  social  mobilization
programmes  for  the  development  of  children  and
women  and  implementing  education  and  training
programmes for this purpose;
